cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(social_nav_levels)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
# Five levels generated by tools/generate_levels.py: Gazebo world, 2-D map, people scenario
# (with robot start/goal) and one Behavior Tree per person.
install(DIRECTORY worlds maps scenarios behavior_trees DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_package()
